snippet.title: Wasabi - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wasabi is a horror thriller game set in 1990s Azumino City, Nagano. Investigate crime scenes, gather evidence, and conduct intense interrogations connected to a terrifying series of murders. 
The mystical powers of Wasabi will reveal the truth!
